_about: Roadway design controls (docs/roadway_control_plan.md). Provisional starting values: AASHTO Green Book where cited, otherwise a proposed default to confirm against the IDOT BLRS Manual's urban tables. Lengths in metres unless a key says _ft; grades and slopes are fractions (0.02 = 2%); K is length per 1% of algebraic grade difference.

policy._decision: 2026-10-18: class limits are values for new designs and cannot account for existing conditions. Fits report violations; they never fail a build or force a profile off the ground.

arterial._source: K: AASHTO stopping sight distance, 35 mph. Max grade: proposed, urban arterial rolling terrain.

collector._source: K: AASHTO SSD, 30 mph. Max grade: proposed.

local._source: K: AASHTO SSD, 25 mph. Max grade: proposed, terrain-limited local street.

service._source: Proposed; alleys and drives have no SSD-governed curves.

profile._source: Proposed drainage minimums for curbed streets; flatter runs get a sawtooth gutter profile.

horizontal._source: Proposed tolerances for fitting design alignments to OSM centrelines. radius_rounding: [[up to radius m, round to m], ...], applied only where the rounded curve stays within the tolerance.

cross_section._decision: 2026-10-18: measure curb-to-curb from the aerial per route, rounded to the nearest foot (class default where it cannot be measured). The gutter flag is 2 ft, new or old, but many have been overlaid with asphalt and show no gutter (a per-route 'overlaid' flag, visible width 0). Older curb may be only 4 in, new curb is 6 in.
cross_section._source: Lanes 12/11/10 ft; gutter and curb per IDOT combination curb and gutter B-6.24 (6 in curb, 24 in gutter); sidewalk cross slope per ADA/PROWAG; daylight slopes 1:4 fill, 1:3 cut. All proposed defaults; real widths to be measured per route from the 6-inch aerial.

modules._decision: 2026-10-18: the node library starts with orthogonal T and 4-leg junctions; others are curated modules.
modules._source: 5 ft panel module; return radii about 10/15/20/25/30 ft; ramp slope per ADA.

clearance._source: 14.5 ft / 16 ft over roads, 23 ft over railroads (AREMA); freeboard proposed.
